page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Compute processing is driven by 52 dedicated vCPUs running on Intel Xeon 8269CY processors with a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The platform is provisioned with 384.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an allocation ratio of approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core.

The hardware configuration does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network cloud storage volumes for all file system and operating system data. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, providing consistent data transfer rates for remote storage connectivity and network traffic. The instance contains zero discrete GPU accelerators and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dense ratio of memory to compute makes ecs.r6.13xlarge cost-efficient for workloads that demand substantial memory buffers without necessitating specialized graphics acceleration or integrated NVMe storage. Tradeoffs include the dependency on remote storage latency and throughput limits for high-IOPS demands. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large enterprise resource planning software, and big data processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization. The system provides 52 dedicated vCPUs driven by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors paired with 384.0 GB of memory, delivering approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU. It features no local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating systems and application data, and operates without GPU acceleration. Network interfaces provide a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps to support sustained cluster communication and storage interactions. The high memory density relative to compute allocation offers efficient resource matching for memory-bound applications without paying for unneeded hardware accelerators. Consequently, ecs.r6.13xlarge is suited for running large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching clusters, memory-heavy data analytics, and enterprise backend platforms.
